title: Magnitude 7+ Earthquakes Still Average 17 A Year
hook: More earthquake reports do not mean more big earthquakes.
closing: More quake headlines reflect better detection, not a more dangerous planet.
question: Have you ever felt an earthquake?

segments.say: Earthquake monitoring expanded to 8,000 stations. Better instruments now catch shaking that older networks missed.
Magnitude 7+ earthquakes average 17 yearly. The biggest events remain close to their century-old rate.
Earthquake catalogs now locate 20,000 events yearly. More sensors created more reports, not more shaking.
